question.worked_solution:
The integral is defined over a type I region.

First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-{x}^{2}-2}^{2-2{x}^{2}}6{x}^{3}\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}6{x}^{3}[{\int }_{-{x}^{2}-2}^{2-2{x}^{2}}dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}6{x}^{3}(2-2{x}^{2}-(-{x}^{2}-2))dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(-6{x}^{5}+24{x}^{3})\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}(24{x}^{3}-6{x}^{5})\,dx & ={[6{x}^{4}-{x}^{6}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(6-1)-0 \\  & =5\end{aligned}
$$
